description: MERA holographic force verification for HYP-2026-002. Binary MERA (16 qubits, 3 layers) with Ry hologron excitations. Compared against exact diagonalization (20-site critical Ising) and AdS analytical prediction from Sahay-Lukin-Cotler (PRX 2026).

hardware_feasibility.verdict: FEASIBLE — 16q well within H2 56q capacity; error budget 5.6% is tight but acceptable for PoC
hardware_feasibility.note: Full 24-qubit version has ~13% CX error budget; remains H2-feasible. 32q pushes to 24%.

quantum.causal_cone_note: Circuit has zero inter-site entanglement beyond dr=4 at depth 15 / 3 layers. Requires 5+ MERA layers to probe full separation range.

classical_baseline.xi_vs_l_AdS_discrepancy: ED xi=3.23 vs theory l_AdS=1.44 (factor 2.2x). Likely sources: (1) open boundary conditions in ED vs periodic in MERA, (2) 20-site finite-size effects, (3) correlator normalization mismatch between raw C(r) and MERA V scale.

comparison_notes: Circuit shape (attractive at dr=1, oscillating at dr=2-4) consistent with existence of holographic force. Absolute scale and sign differ from AdS prediction because MERA params are pre-initialized (not variationally optimized to critical Ising ground state). ED xi mismatch (3.23 vs 1.44) points to finite-size and boundary effects. Full verification requires: (1) VQE optimization of MERA params, (2) 5+ MERA layers for full causal cone coverage, (3) periodic boundary conditions in ED.

findings.description: Rz hologrons give V=0 identically because Rz commutes with ZZ observable. Must use Ry (or Rx) for non-commuting hologron excitations. This is a fundamental physics constraint, not a bug.
findings.action: Updated circuit to use Ry(pi/3) hologrons. mera_circuit_hyp002.py patched.

findings.description: MERA causal cone at depth 15 / 3 layers limits entanglement reach to dr<=4 on a 16-qubit chain. Sites at dr>=5 show V=0 (no entanglement propagated).
findings.action: Increase to 5 MERA layers for 24-qubit full circuit. This doubles depth to ~30 and CX count to ~58, still H2-feasible.

findings.description: Pre-initialized MERA params (analytically motivated, not VQE-optimized) produce wrong absolute scale. chi^2/dof=12204, indicating ~200-sigma disagreement per point. Parameters must be optimized to approximate the critical Ising ground state.
findings.action: Run VQE with energy minimization on qiskit-aer before H2 submission. Estimated 500-1000 VQE iterations.

findings.description: H2 hardware submission is feasible at 16q. Accumulated CX error budget is 5.64% for the PoC circuit, within acceptable range for a proof-of-concept. Full 24q circuit budget is 13.3%, still viable.
findings.action: After VQE optimization, submit to Quantinuum H2 with explicit user approval per CLAUDE.md rules.

next_steps: Run VQE energy minimization on qiskit-aer to optimize 146 MERA parameters to critical Ising ground state
Extend to 5 MERA layers (24 qubits) to probe full dr=1..8 separation range within causal cone
Run ED with periodic boundary conditions and larger system (N>=28) to reduce finite-size xi mismatch
After optimization confirms force profile shape, request user approval for Quantinuum H2 hardware submission
Correlate xi extraction from MERA circuit fit against l_AdS=1.4427 as key falsifiable prediction
notes: Simulation uses analytically-motivated MERA parameters, not VQE-optimized. Results are proof-of-concept for circuit architecture validity, not final experimental data. Hardware submission requires explicit user approval.
